images.author: El.Sarmiento
images.why: 4000 × 2248. Close view of Margherita and Alexandra peaks with glaciers; strong summit-focused option. DR Congo shooting side is unverified.

images.author: El.Sarmiento
images.why: 4320 × 2432. Recognisable overview of the complete Stanley massif; crop toward Margherita on the right. DR Congo shooting side is unverified.

images.author: Rafał Kozubek
images.why: 5184 × 3888. Eastern, Uganda-side view of the Stanley Glacier beneath Alexandra and Margherita; ample resolution for a 9:10 crop.

images.author: Albert Backer
images.why: 2592 × 1614. Explicitly photographed from Uganda’s Central Circuit; a classic approach view centred on Margherita Peak.

images.author: Byekwaso Blasio
images.why: 3888 × 2592. Snow and glacier contrast against dark summit rock and blue sky; attractive twin-peak composition. Shooting side is not explicitly documented.

images.author: Wilfredor
images.why: 2789 × 2276. Recognisable summit portrait with rugged rock and remaining snow; relatively compact framing suits a near-square crop.

images.author: Nancy Pestana González
images.why: 3264 × 2448. Snow-bearing Pico Bolívar photographed with a telephoto setting; useful for a card emphasising the mountain itself.

images.author: Oscar Costero
images.why: 5152 × 3864. Documented view from Pico el Toro; high-resolution alternative with substantial room to crop around Bolívar.

images.author: M M (Padmanaba01)
images.why: 4592 × 3448. High-resolution expedition photograph of Pico Bolívar; its 4:3 proportions leave useful flexibility for the poster crop.

images.author: Mário Simoes
images.why: 6000 × 4246. Expedition photograph explicitly identifying Carstensz Pyramid; the highest-resolution candidate here, with generous cropping latitude.

images.author: Enda Kaban
images.why: 2329 × 2969. Portrait helicopter photograph of the snow-covered mountain; naturally suited to 9:10, although clouds make it a less clear-sky option.

images.author: Tangopaso
images.why: 4416 × 3312. Classic French-side view from Planpraz above Chamonix; clearly identified Mont Blanc summit and ample resolution for a near-square crop.

images.author: Daondo
images.why: 2560 × 1920. Iconic Mont Blanc view from Le Brévent on the French side; convenient 4:3 composition for summit-centred cropping.

images.author: Emmanuel Boutet
images.why: 2560 × 1438. Twilight view from Chamonix offers a different lighting mood; a 9:10 crop will retain less detail than the larger alternatives.
